svg.title: Dat Rosa Mel Apibus
svg.desc: After the title vignette of Summum Bonum ([Frankfurt], 1629): a rose of seven circles of seven petals on a cross-shaped stem, a bee alighted on it and others in flight; on the left a grape trellis with two spiders’ webs of seven rays; on the right four beehives; above, the motto Dat Rosa Mel Apibus.
